'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Bot Incursion [[Special Mission|Spotlight Mission]] that ran from January 13th ~ January 27th, 2022.

== Synopsis ==
There seems to be something new and scary happening on New Quintessa. While Wheeljack is off researching it, another Bot is looking for more immediate actions. SHOCKWAVE is taking the Commander for a trip deeper into the anomaly to retrieve some Decepticon Seekers! Will this mission spell doom and gloom? We’ll have to see as we take FIGHT OR FLIGHT!
